title: Migrate bee-hive SKILL.md to thin-body doctrine (30.1K -> <=8192)
action: Rewrite skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md to the D7 thin-body doctrine: body keeps ONLY (1) trigger + lane scaling, (2) one flow/step table, (3) load-bearing invariants (Red Flags stay), (4) the reference routing table. Rewrite mechanics per plan: law-paragraph -> table row or <=2-line bullet, one idea per line, <=80 chars/line target, delete reassurance clauses, exceptions-of-exceptions -> the branch's reference. MEANING NEVER CHANGES: every rule keeps its normative content; every removed section reachable through the routing table (P1 acceptance). Preserve intact: (a) every okf_instructions_fence-graded bundle-branch line (fence must stay green), (b) the skill_lint pointer targets 'Progress ticks' and 'Re-lane checkpoint' — body must keep pointers with those exact quoted headings resolving into references, (c) bee:only marker grammar if present. Then update scripts/skill-body-budget.json: lower bee-hive entry to the new exact byte size (<=8192), append "bee-hive" to migrated[], delete notes["bee-hive"]. Do NOT edit other skills' bodies. Do NOT touch fence/lint/run_verify logic. REGEN OBLIGATION (in THIS cell, in order): node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write — the rendered mirrors and manifest ship in the same commit.
